create_llff_dataset: create an LLFFDataset instance from a config to load LLFF scene poses, images, and ray directions
create_dense_llff_dataset: create a DenseLLFFDataset instance to load grid-arranged LLFF scenes with row and column skip logic
review_llff_read_meta: review the LLFFDataset read_meta method that parses poses_bounds.npy, computes intrinsics, and splits train/val sets
review_dense_llff_read_meta: review the DenseLLFFDataset read_meta method that loads separate bounds.npy and poses.npy with grid-based train/val splitting
refactor_llff_get_coords: refactor the LLFFDataset get_coords method to compute camera rays and optionally convert to NDC space
